items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: I played music with him with Georgie Parker Band at Happyland and out the lake. We played there about four years.

ctx.x: That's why I lost a year I'm a plasterer. I guess you knew Johnny St. Cyr, did you? Good friend of mine.
I played music with him with Georgie Parker Band at Happyland and out the lake. We played there about four years.
When was that? That wouldn't be awfully long ago I guess. With Georgie Parker?
